206-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-2113-3249-5687--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-2464-3249-7316--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2105-3337-7748.easyPrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Ant-Man.
2105-3337-7748.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Ant-Man and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, the token Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When you deal combat damage, Ant-Man triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

728-967-3809-6753-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

225-3129-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-3129-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

549-2685-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-5641-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1849-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-1849-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2685-4321-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4321-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4302-5231-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5231-5929.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat.

2438-4694-7652.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2445-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Branching Evolution.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Branching Evolution.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

6798-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6798-7084-7316.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3771-4217-7302.notablePrerequisites: Animar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3771-4217-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-5500-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

570-662-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
570-662-1978.description:
Cause Faeburrow Elder to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2438-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2438-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2173-2438-3845-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

488-641-874-1482-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Jeweled Lotus must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-874-1482-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

710-2292-3055.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-2292-3055.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3869-4067-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to green is at least two.
Your combined devotion to blue and green is at least twelve.
3869-4067-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to your devotion to that color.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat, alternating the colors of mana you add using Nykthos.

624-1525-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Phantasmal Image is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
624-1525-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
624-1525-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

856-4321-5231-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5231-5477.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {R}.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1912-4131-4241.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-4241.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, making Basalt Monolith a 3/3 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

307-3542-4307.notablePrerequisites:
Yuriko and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Yuriko or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
307-3542-4307.description:
Declare Palinchron and Yuriko as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Yuriko from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yuriko's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Yuriko onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

140-2100-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-2100-5195.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2353-2428-4691.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-2428-4691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Horizon Chimera trigger.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2510-3227-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3227-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scrivener, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
